key_plays: Q1 2:07: Jameis Winston ran for a 1-yard touchdown to put New York ahead 10-3.
Q2 6:04: J.J. McCarthy threw an 8-yard touchdown pass to Malik Nabers, extending New York's lead to 17-6.
Q3 4:02: Josh Hines-Allen forced a Cam Skattebo fumble; Antonio Johnson recovered it and returned it 42 yards.
Q4 11:08: Adebo intercepted Trevor Lawrence at the Jaguars' 28-yard line.
Q4 6:47: Trevor Lawrence threw an 18-yard touchdown pass to Brian Thomas Jr.; the two-point pass was intercepted.

recap.paragraph: 23 points helped the Giants beat the Jaguars 23-18 in New York! Jameis Winston ran for a touchdown to put the Giants ahead. J.J. McCarthy then zipped a touchdown pass to Malik Nabers. Antonio Johnson returned a Jaguars fumble 42 yards. Later, Adebo intercepted a Trevor Lawrence pass. Lawrence hit Brian Thomas Jr. for a touchdown, but the 2-point pass was picked off! The Giants stayed in first place in the NFC East, while the Jaguars kept their AFC South lead.
